speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and how long it has been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any close family members who have experienced similar skin or neurological symptoms? Also, does the rash appear to have a specific pattern, such as linear streaks?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the combination of pruritus, peripheral neuropathy, and Madaras sign, I suspect a parasitic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin Scraping_KOH.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal KOH prep rules out fungal infection, but your symptoms strongly suggest Cutaneous Leishmaniasis or a similar parasitic issue. REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings, combined with your neuropathy and Madaras sign, strongly point to leprosy. To determine the specific classification and guide treatment, do you have any skin smears or nerve conduction studies available?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Reduced sensory nerve action potentials in the ulnar nerves.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy showing chronic inflammation, combined with Madaras sign, peripheral neuropathy, and your occupation, confirms Hansen's disease. DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy
